Merge taxonomy and kingdom data into a single dataframe

Source: R/taxonomyRanked.R
taxonomyRanked.Rd

taxonomyRanked merges taxonomy and kingdom information about the queried EPPO code into a single dataframe.

Usage

taxonomyRanked(taxonomy, kingdom)

Arguments

taxonomy

a dataframe containing taxonomy data about the queried EPPO code.

kingdom

a dataframe containing kingdom data about the queried EPPO code.

Value

A dataframe containing taxonomy and kingdom information about the queried EPPO code.

Examples

# Get taxonomy and kingdom data about Bemisia tabaci:
taxonomy <- queryTheEPPOForService("BEMITA", service = "taxonomy")
kingdom <- queryTheEPPOForService("BEMITA", service = "kingdom")

# Merge taxonomy and kingdom information about Bemisia tabaci into a single dataframe:
taxonomyRanked(taxonomy, kingdom)
